apps.name: Clip Farm Pilot
apps.subtitle: Turn livestreams into clips entirely on-device.
apps.localizedDescription: Clip Farm Pilot finds strong moments in livestream recordings and turns them into social clips without uploading the source video. Import a local video, choose or automatically detect a clip range, add square or live captions, apply filters and effects, then export the MP4 directly on your iPhone or iPad.

permissions.usageDescription: Choose livestream videos to edit entirely on this device.
Create optional live captions using only the speech model installed on this device.

apps.versionDescription: First fully local iPhone and iPad sideload release.

versions.localizedDescription: First fully local iPhone and iPad sideload release.
